violation_categories.description: Wage violations including below-minimum wage, delayed payment, non-payment

applicable_laws.title: Minimum Wage
applicable_laws.detail: Every employer shall pay wages not less than the minimum wage prescribed by the Minister
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 100,000 or imprisonment up to 2 years

applicable_laws.title: Payment of Wages
applicable_laws.detail: Wages shall be paid at regular intervals not exceeding one month

applicable_laws.title: Agricultural Minimum Wage
applicable_laws.detail: Daily minimum wage for agricultural workers ranges from KES 282.90 (unskilled) to KES 418.40 (drivers)

process: Visit the nearest Labour Office with your national ID

remedy_pathways.action: File court case for wage recovery
process: Visit the court with your ID
File a statement of claim (KES 1,000 filing fee)
Free legal aid available through NLAS

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Umepokea mshahara chini ya kiwango cha chini? Hii ni kinyume na sheria. Kiwango cha chini kwa wafanyakazi wa kilimo ni KES 282.90 kwa siku. Unaweza kukataa ofisi ya kazi au mahakama.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: You are being paid below minimum wage? This is illegal. The minimum daily wage for agricultural workers is KES 282.90. You can file a complaint at the Labour Office or Court.

violation_categories.description: Working without a written employment contract

applicable_laws.title: Written Contract
applicable_laws.detail: An employer shall issue a written contract to an employee within two months of employment

applicable_laws.title: Particulars of Employment
applicable_laws.detail: Employer must provide written particulars including name, address, job description, wages, hours of work

process: Visit Labour Office with national ID
Report that employer has not issued a written contract
Labour officer will require employer to issue contract
Employer fined if they fail to comply
documents_needed: Evidence of employment (M-Pesa statements, photos, witness statements)

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Huna mkataba wa maandishi? Sheria inasema mkataba lazima upewe ndani ya miezi 2. Hii ni haki yako.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: No written contract? The law requires employers to provide a written contract within 2 months. This is your right.

violation_categories.description: Lack of personal protective equipment (PPE) and unsafe working conditions

applicable_laws.title: Provision of PPE
applicable_laws.detail: Every employer shall provide and maintain suitable PPE at no cost to the employee
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 500,000 or imprisonment up to 2 years

applicable_laws.title: Duty to Ensure Safety
applicable_laws.detail: Every employer shall ensure that the workplace is safe and without risk to health

applicable_laws.title: Safe Handling of Agrochemicals
applicable_laws.detail: Proper training and protective equipment required for handling pesticides

remedy_pathways.institution: Directorate of Occupational Safety and Health Services (DOSHS)
process: Call DOSHS hotline or visit nearest office
Report lack of PPE and unsafe conditions
Employer required to provide PPE immediately

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Hawakupi barakoa au vifaa vya usalama? Hii ni kinyume na sheria. Kazi za kilimo hasa kunyunyizia dawa zinahitaji barakoa, glavu, na mavazi maalum. Ofisi ya DOSHS inaweza kuchunguza.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: No PPE or safety equipment provided? This is illegal. Agricultural work, especially spraying chemicals, requires masks, gloves, and protective clothing. DOSHS can investigate.

applicable_laws.title: Prohibition of Child Labour
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall employ a child under 16 years for any form of labour
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 500,000 or imprisonment up to 5 years

applicable_laws.title: Hazardous Work for Children
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall employ a child in any hazardous work including agriculture with chemicals
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 1,000,000 or imprisonment up to 10 years

applicable_laws.title: Best Interest of the Child
applicable_laws.detail: All actions concerning children shall consider the best interest of the child as the primary consideration

process: Visit the nearest Children's Office or Chief's office

remedy_pathways.institution: Kenya Police - Gender and Children's Desk
process: Visit any police station with Children's Desk

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Je, unajua mtoto anafanya kazi hatari? Hii ni uhalifu mkubwa. Watoto chini ya miaka 16 hawaruhusiwi kufanya kazi za kilimo hasa na dawa za kemikali. Wasiliana na Ofisi ya Watoto au Polisi.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: Do you know a child doing hazardous work? This is a serious crime. Children under 16 cannot work in agriculture, especially with chemicals. Contact Children's Office or Police.

applicable_laws.title: Right to Clean Environment
applicable_laws.detail: Every person has the right to a clean and healthy environment
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 10,000,000 or imprisonment up to 5 years

applicable_laws.title: Water Quality Regulations
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall discharge pollutants into water sources

applicable_laws.title: Prohibition of Deforestation
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall cut, burn, or destroy a forest without authorization

process: Download or visit NET offices for complaint form
Pay filing fee (KES 2,000) - fee waiver available for communities
NEMA investigates and issues enforcement notices

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Kampuni inaichafua mazingira? Hii ni kinyume na sheria. Unaweza kulalamika kwa NEMA au Tribunal ya Mazingira. Haki yako ni mazingira safi.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: Is a company polluting the environment? This is illegal. You can complain to NEMA or the Environment Tribunal. Your right is a clean environment.

violation_categories.description: Gender-based violence and sexual harassment in the workplace

applicable_laws.title: Sexual Harassment
applicable_laws.detail: No employer shall sexually harass an employee. Sexual harassment includes unwelcome advances, requests for sexual favors, and other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature
applicable_laws.penalty: Fine up to KES 100,000 or imprisonment up to 3 years

applicable_laws.title: Sexual Harassment
applicable_laws.detail: Any person who sexually harasses another commits an offence

applicable_laws.title: Acts of Domestic Violence
applicable_laws.detail: Includes physical, sexual, emotional, and economic abuse

process: Visit any police station with a Gender Desk
PPO certificate issued for medical examination
Visit NGEC offices or call hotline

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Unanyanyaswa kazi? Hii ni halifu. Unaweza kulalamika kwa Polisi - Kitengo cha Jinsia au NGEC. Usijichelewe. Unastahili kazi salama.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: Are you being harassed at work? This is a crime. You can report to Police - Gender Desk or NGEC. Don't wait. You deserve a safe workplace.

violation_categories.description: Land rights violations including forced eviction, land grabbing, and unfair lease terms

applicable_laws.title: Protection of Right to Property
applicable_laws.detail: Every person has the right to own property. No person shall be arbitrarily deprived of property

applicable_laws.title: Land Administration Principles
applicable_laws.detail: Land shall be managed sustainably and equitably

applicable_laws.title: Forced Eviction Prohibition
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall be evicted without a court order and adequate notice

process: Court issues interim orders if urgent

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Shamba lako linachukuliwa? Haki ya ardhi ni haki ya kikatiba. Unaweza kulalamika kwa Mahakama ya Ardhi au Tume ya Kitaifa ya Ardhi.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: Your land is being taken? Land rights are constitutional rights. You can complain to the Land Court or National Land Commission.

violation_categories.description: Certification fraud, audit manipulation, and non-compliance with standards

applicable_laws.title: False or Misleading Representations
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall make false or misleading representations about goods or services

applicable_laws.title: Prohibition of False Marketing
applicable_laws.detail: No person shall engage in false or misleading conduct in trade or commerce

process: Visit CAK offices or file online

violation_categories.instant_response_sw: Kampuni inadai certification feki? Hii ni udanganyifu. Unaweza kulalamika kwa CAK.
violation_categories.instant_response_en: Is a company claiming fake certification? This is fraud. You can report to CAK.

national.name: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection
Directorate of Occupational Safety and Health Services (DOSHS)
Kenya National Commission on Human Rights (KNCHR)
